notes.title: "RatCage" releases on January 30, 2023.
notes.content:
"RatCage" is finally releasing in less than a month.
The game will be completed soon.
It will be released on January 30, 2023.

The rat wanders into a dangerous building on a freezing winter night.
There are various gimmicks in the building, and the rat is in danger.
Overcome difficulties and escape the building safely!
